name: Shaftesbury hillside
description: Scrubland below Gold Hill, one of England's steepest streets. Room for a school, if you can terrace the slope.
attribution: Terrain: Terrain Tiles (AWS Open Data / Mapzen), including data from SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1, EU-DEM (Copernicus) and national LIDAR sources

licence.note: Derived from OpenStreetMap data, available under the Open Database Licence. Show '© OpenStreetMap contributors' wherever this site is used.

axes: metres; x east, y up, z south (-z is north); y = 0 is the plot's mean ground level

terrain.encoding: float32le, row-major, rows run +z (north to south), columns run +x (west to east)

factors.label: Sloping site
factors.detail: Falls about 20% to the south-west, 14.3 m across the plot. Expect cut and fill, retaining walls or stepped foundations.

factors.label: No road frontage
factors.detail: No vehicle road touches the plot (nearest 29 m away). Deliveries and cranes need a temporary haul road or a lift over neighbours.

factors.label: Awkward plot shape
factors.detail: Irregular outline (fills 61% of its bounding rectangle).

factors.label: Neighbours close to the boundary
factors.detail: 2 building(s) within 6 m of the boundary, the nearest 3.6 m away. Needs careful excavation, scaffolding and demolition.

buildings.name: PWCR Architects, and The Courtyard Offices
